pilot_candidates.definition: Straight 3D Euclidean distance from anterior nasal tip to subnasale, the midline junction of the underside of the nose and upper lip. Locally proposed nasal chord, not claimed equivalent to either published nose protrusion or bridge height.

Straight 3D distance from deepest nasal-root depression to inferior midline chin point. Independent target, not the scale anchor. Yu 2024 Table 1 describes this face-length span; practical annotation protocol remains unreviewed.

Must specify local reference plane and landmark/surface patch. Not the subjective Abbott category or ARKit nose-path sum.

physical_scale_anchor.definition: Tape follows the facial surface from one tragion through subnasale to the opposite tragion; matched reconstruction must follow the same contact route. Endpoints alone do not define intermediate tape contact. Not a chord or automatically the shortest mesh geodesic.
physical_scale_anchor.required_protocol: Mark tragion/subnasale consistently; guided side views and full ear-adjacent surface coverage; light consistent tape contact, repeated mm readings, self-versus-assisted comparison. Human review and repeatability still pending.
physical_scale_anchor.alternative_anchor_status: No validated physical alternative selected. Analytic fixture ridge is only a mathematical smoke-test anchor.
